ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetStatusSuccess..description: GetStatusSuccess discloses pinned freshness, coverage, and projection truth.

coverage.description: coverage discloses canonical versus indexed counts without existence detail.

freshness.description: freshness pins the current complete generation and discloses its state.

projection.description: projection discloses the rebuildable projection state; absence is not deletion.
projection.title: Projection State

source.description: source is the authorized opaque source reference.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetStatusSuccess..title: Get Status Success

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GitSnapshot.jsons.description: GitSnapshot is server-authored canonical metadata for one committed tree.

commitOid.description: commit_oid is the resolved local committed Git object ID.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest is authored after normalizing ignore and symlink policy.

snapshotId.description: snapshot_id names the immutable snapshot fact.

treeOid.description: tree_oid is the exact root tree resolved from commit_oid.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GitSnapshot.jsons.title: Git Snapshot

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.IngestionGenerati.description: IngestionGeneration identifies one immutable source projection generation.

generationId.description: generation_id is the opaque immutable generation identity.

languageReadiness.description: language_readiness contains exactly one record for each P5 language.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonic within the source.

snapshot.description: snapshot pins the exact committed Git inputs.

sourceWatermark.description: source_watermark is the complete canonical source position observed.

state.description: state distinguishes unservable, ready, and degraded generations.
state.title: Generation State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.IngestionGenerati.title: Ingestion Generation

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LanguageReadiness.description: LanguageReadiness reports one P5 lane's syntax-aware or degraded state.

coverage.description: coverage distinguishes bounded syntax awareness from lexical degradation.
coverage.title: Coverage State

language.description: language identifies exactly one P5 language.
language.title: Code Language

reasonCode.description: reason_code is a stable non-sensitive explanation for degraded coverage.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LanguageReadiness.title: Language Readiness

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryCoverage.jso.description: QueryCoverage discloses canonical versus indexed coverage without existence detail.

canonicalRevisionCount.description: canonical_revision_count counts canonical revisions in the pinned generation.

indexedRevisionCount.description: indexed_revision_count counts revisions present in the search projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryCoverage.jso.title: Query Coverage

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryFreshness.js.description: QueryFreshness pins one complete Stage 03 generation and discloses its state.

aclEpoch.description: acl_epoch records the authorization epoch used for hydration decisions.

generation.description: generation pins the exact served committed-Git generation and readiness.

observedAt.description: observed_at records when the freshness state was evaluated.

state.description: state discloses whether the pinned generation is current, stale, or degraded.
state.title: Freshness State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryFreshness.js.title: Query Freshness

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceReference.j.description: SourceReference is server-authored and never exposes an absolute filesystem path.

brainId.description: brain_id prevents same-tenant cross-brain projection reuse.

repositoryId.description: repository_id is the server-authored opaque repository scope.

sourceId.description: source_id is the opaque canonical source identity.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceReference.j.title: Source Reference
